At a Massachusetts community pharmacy, the pharmacist is on duty and available. Each proposed assignment below is evaluated with the employee’s current state license and certification. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

A.original_option_text: A pharmacy technician trainee accepts an unchanged verbal refill authorization for lisinopril.
A.finding_ko: 틀린 처리 — 변경없는III–VI refill verbal authorization 권한에서도 PTT는 제외된다. full technician의 업무를 trainee에게 옮기지 않는다.

B.original_option_text: A supervised Massachusetts intern counsels a patient about a newly prescribed inhaler.
B.finding_ko: 옳은 처리 — 적절한 pharmacist 감독을 받는 MA intern도 counseling을 할 수 있다. 새 inhaler의 방향과 주의사항 설명은 허용 counselor의 역할이다.

C.original_option_text: A nationally certified technician receives an emergency oral oxycodone authorization directly from the prescribing practitioner.
C.finding_ko: 틀린 처리 — emergency oral CII는 prescribing practitioner의 authorization을 pharmacist가 받는 경로다. certified technician의 new verbalIII–VI권한을 oxycodone CII로 확대하지 않는다.

D.original_option_text: An external maintenance worker enters the prescription area alone because the pharmacy has issued a visitor badge.
D.finding_ko: 틀린 처리 — external vendor는 pharmacist에게 accompanied and monitored되어야 prescription area에 접근할 수 있다. visitor badge만으로 단독입장을 허용하지 않는다.

E.original_option_text: A trained cashier selects an unfilled prescription stock bottle and counts tablets before ringing up the sale.
E.finding_ko: 틀린 처리 — cashier의 예외는 filled/verified/bagged 처방판매와 offer전달이다. unfinished stock bottle 선택·tablet count는 허용된 cashier업무가 아니다.

records.original_stem:
A Massachusetts pharmacist is reviewing patient-facing procedures for outpatient prescriptions. Each patient is receiving medication rather than an inpatient medication order. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

A.original_option_text: A pharmacist assesses whether a clinically significant change warrants renewed counseling even though the patient has used the drug before.
A.finding_ko: 옳은 처리 — 각newtherapy뿐아니라 pharmacistjudgment상 건강·안전에 중요한therapy도 counseling한다. 과거복용했다는이유만으로 clinicallysignificantchange를배제하지않는다.

B.original_option_text: A nationally certified technician explains a new medicine’s directions and important precautions as the clinical counselor.
B.finding_ko: 틀린 처리 — counseling은 pharmacist/intern의업무다. nationallycertified technician이라도 clinicalcounselor로 directions/precautions를설명할수없다.

C.original_option_text: A pharmacist records a patient’s actual refusal after offering available counseling.
C.finding_ko: 옳은 처리 — 실제 counseling offer후 환자의실제거절을사실대로기록하는것은 단순서두름을거절로추정하거나completedcounseling으로꾸미는것과다르다. 모든환자에게특정양식이강제된다는인증은아니다.

D.original_option_text: A pharmacy provides a consultation area where the discussion can be visually and audibly confidential.
D.finding_ko: 옳은 처리 — designated consultationarea는 confidential visual/auditory counseling을위한 adequateprivacy를제공해야한다. 실제보호되는공간을제공하는처리다.

E.original_option_text: A pharmacist supplies or recommends a suitable measuring device with an oral liquid.
